title: Weekly sales pipeline
segments: Morning everyone. Quick pipeline review. We're at 1.4 million in qualified pipeline for Q4, target is 1.8.
Biggest update: Northwind signed yesterday, 120 thousand annual contract, three-year term.
Great work Tom. What about Contoso? They were supposed to decide last week.
Contoso pushed to December 5th. Their legal team wants changes to the data processing agreement.
Let's get our legal team on that this week. Tom, send their redlines to legal today.
On my side, Fabrikam is stuck. Their champion left the company and the new VP hasn't replied in two weeks.
Try going through their CFO, we met her at the conference in October. If nothing by the 20th, mark it as at risk.
Will do. I also have three new inbound leads from the webinar, all mid-market, around 30 to 50 thousand each.
Good. Book discovery calls with all three before Friday.
One concern: our discount approvals are slow. Contoso asked for fifteen percent and it took four days to get approval.
Agreed. New rule: discounts up to ten percent you can approve yourselves, anything above comes to me and I answer within 24 hours.
Last thing, the CRM data is messy. Everyone please update close dates and stages by Wednesday so the forecast is accurate.

key_points.point: Contoso pushed to Dec 5 over data processing agreement; redlines to legal
Fabrikam stuck (champion left); go via CFO, at risk if nothing by the 20th
Three inbound webinar leads ($30-50k); discovery calls before Friday
Discounts up to 10% self-approved; above goes to Rachel, answered within 24h
Update CRM close dates and stages by Wednesday

action_items.text: Tom sends Contoso redlines to legal today
Lisa books discovery calls before Friday
